# Psychotherapy Networker

> > A leading professional publication for psychotherapists covering clinical practice, therapeutic approaches, neuroscience, and contemporary mental health issues.

Psychotherapy Networker features in-depth articles on evidence-based practice, therapeutic relationships, family therapy, couples therapy, and emerging clinical challenges. The publication bridges neuroscience research (including Paul MacLean's triune brain theory) with practical therapeutic interventions, while addressing contemporary issues like trauma, attachment, and cultural competence in mental health treatment.

## Key Topics

- Therapeutic relationship
- Evidence-based practice
- Couples therapy
- Family therapy
- Attachment therapy
- PTSD and trauma
- Neuroscience in psychotherapy
- Triune brain theory
- Therapeutic interventions
- Brain structure and function
- DBT and borderline personality disorder
- Cultural competence
- Psychotherapy effectiveness
- Play therapy and neurodivergence

## Neuroscience and Psychotherapy Theory

- [The Triune Brain: Three Brains Attempting to Work as One](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/triune-brain-three-brains-attempting-work-one): MacLean's triune brain theory: reptilian, limbic, neocortex structures
- [The Problem with the Borderline Diagnosis](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/problem-borderline-diagnosis): BPD diagnosis critique: Linehan's DBT & attachment trauma perspectives
- [Is Psychotherapy Getting Better?](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/psychotherapy-getting-better): Evaluating psychotherapy effectiveness since Eysenck's 1952 critique

## Couples and Family Therapy

- [Embracing the Other](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/embracing-other): Cross-cultural couples therapy with PTSD: Abby & Jeremy in Baltimore
- ["I'm Not That Guy"](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/im-not-guy): Couples therapy navigating #MeToo movement & gender politics
- [Get Out of My Life!](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/get-out-my-life): Family estrangement & reconciliation therapy interventions
- [Functional Family Therapy: A New Road Map for Behavioral Change](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/functional-family-therapy-new-road-map-behavioral-change): FFT evidence-based approach for juvenile delinquency & family therapy

## Attachment and Developmental Issues

- [A Playful Path to Attachment](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/playful-path-attachment): Attachment therapy case: Elaine & adopted daughter Natasha from Russia
- [Free Play with Neurodivergent Kids](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/free-play-neurodivergent-kids): Play therapy for autism: DIRFloortime vs ABA approaches with Grandin
- [The Challenge of Helping the People Pleaser](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/challenge-helping-people-pleaser): Treating people-pleasing behaviors & boundary issues in therapy

## Contemporary Clinical Challenges

- [Supreme Testimony](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/supreme-testimony): Blasey Ford testimony, trauma survivors, & Kavanaugh hearing impact
- [It's Not about the Diet](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/its-not-about-diet): Treating overeating, binge eating, & body image beyond diet culture
- [Pornography on the Rise: A Growing Mental Health Problem](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/pornography-rise-growing-mental-health-problem): Internet pornography addiction impact on mental health & relationships

## Clinical Wisdom and Perspectives

- [Erv Polster on How Aging Changes Therapy](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/erv-polster-how-aging-changes-therapy): Gestalt therapist Erv Polster on aging, mortality, & clinical wisdom
- [Editor's Note - March/April 2014](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/editors-note-marchapril-2014): Editor's critique of DSM diagnostic paradigm in mental health
- [Editor's Note - November/December 2016](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/editors-note-novemberdecember-2016): Digital therapy revolution: apps, VR, & therapeutic relationships
- [Editor's Note - November/December 2015](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/editors-note-novemberdecember-2015): Editor's note on Ferguson, Baltimore, and systemic racism in therapy

## Personal Narratives

- [Isle of Dreams](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/isle-dreams): Personal narrative: Ireland journey, grief recovery, ancestral roots
- [Karaoke on Five South](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/karaoke-five-south): Personal narrative: Keara's psychiatric hospitalization & ECT treatment
- [Tough Choices](https://www.psychotherapynetworker.org/article/tough-choices): Family caregiving decisions: elder care & wilderness therapy challenges
